integrity: The proof is analytic; supplementary checker has finitely many exact symbolic and floating-point tests and cannot replace the proof. No authorship, independent certification or external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-data uniqueness and full-intensity linear interpolation for noncircular ellipses. No uniform numerical stability at clustered nodes or degenerating ellipticity; no nonlinear measurement minimality, no algorithm for stable polynomial factorization, and no general necessity of product condition for arbitrary nonuniform sets. Historical priority provisional; independent audit not performed.
title: Four-per-degree phaseless sampling on a noncircular ellipse and exact angular resonance
